title: <Title> — payload
description: What the request payload carries. The outer members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) belong to the framework, not to this schema. For a private task replace the $id host with your own authority.

exampleMember.description: Free text must declare maxLength. Say in spec.md who reads it, whether it is retained and that it is untrusted.

when.description: Instants are RFC 3339 strings named <event>At (for example recordedAt), never Unix seconds.

ttlSeconds.description: Durations are integers with the unit in the name.

Response.description: Success payload, for documents typed <Type URI>#response. Delete this whole $defs.Response for a fire-and-forget task. Failures use trust-task-error, never this shape.

outcome.description: Prefer a closed enum to free text.
